palette: 军绿 wire + 黄铜 brass + 纸白 paper + 朱红 alert + 钢青 steel + 墨 ink
typography: heavy wire headings, square official chips, steel label blocks, double-frame stamps
composition: a wartime wire dispatch room: espionage conduct types with defection board, the narrowed intelligence definition with the knowing-or-not fork, and the four-corner state secrets comparison bench
surface: dispatch paper grain, square official chips, dashed exclusion zones, double-frame stamps; no glossy panels
